stem: Approximately what proportion of children with febrile seizures develop febrile status epilepticus?
explanation: Febrile status epilepticus occurs in about 5% of children with febrile seizures.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 111

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because the proportion is higher than 1%.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because febrile status epilepticus occurs in about 5% of children with febrile seizures.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 10% is higher than the figure given for febrile status epilepticus.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 25% is much higher than the figure given for febrile status epilepticus.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 50% is far above the proportion associated with febrile status epilepticus.
